summary: Enhance your skills with our Contract and Procurement Audit Training Course. Learn essential techniques to ensure compliance and improve procurement processes.
lede: Procurement auditing examines purchasing controls and contract performance across the source-to-pay cycle, from supplier selection and approvals to delivery and payment. For experienced procurement auditors, contract managers, and internal auditors, this course provides a practical approach to planning risk-based audits, testing tender decisions and contract obligations, and analyzing purchasing data for exceptions. Learners also practice documenting evidence and presenting findings with corrective actions.
audienceIntro: Contract and Procurement Audit Training suits professionals who examine purchasing integrity, contract performance, supplier governance, and financial control across the full source-to-pay cycle. It is designed for experienced practitioners who can relate audit tests to operational decisions and executive reporting.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in procurement, contract administration, internal audit, compliance, commercial management, accounts payable, or supplier governance. Familiarity with purchase orders, tender files, contract registers, invoices, and approval workflows will help you contribute effectively. No programming is required. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted document review, automated exception detection, ISO 37001 controls, and Power BI-style reporting are taught at operational application or conceptual awareness level, not production engineering level. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to reproduce the exercises.
